inspection.basis: direct visual inspection at original resolution

operatorSafety.summary: Happy or neutral isolated creature/object studies; no infestation, corruption, cavity clusters, or multiplicity hazards observed.

policy.nonFur: Promote every non-fur output, including shell-collapse controls, because TRELLIS is cheap and the failures help map reconstruction preferences.
policy.fur: Promote all three short-fur outputs because every seed produced a coherent, isolated, structurally legible creature.

neutral-seed80301.note: Plausible hairless mammal; authored support placement and body axis remain legible.

neutral-seed80302.note: Canid-like completion with strong authored silhouette retention.

neutral-seed80413.note: Unfamiliar green mammal; useful prior-shift test with preserved macrostructure.

skin-seed80301.note: Literal skin treatment; highly constrained silhouette and support layout.

skin-seed80302.note: Literal skin treatment with modest seed-specific proportion shift.

skin-seed80413.note: Literal skin treatment; surface blemishes present but no operator no-go pattern.

short-fur-seed80301.note: Dense coherent fur; bear-like prior but clean silhouette.

short-fur-seed80302.note: Strongest fur candidate; feline/canid structure remains readable through surface detail.

short-fur-seed80413.note: Dense coherent fur; useful cross-seed reconstruction test.

armor-seed80301.note: Broad local plates preserve organism and articulate around authored supports.

armor-seed80302.note: Most literal plate-localization result; strong rigid/deformable segmentation candidate.

armor-seed80413.note: Heavier armor basin while preserving support and body organization.

shell-seed80301.note: Prompt overwrote the organism with an almost literal shell object.

shell-seed80302.note: Organism survives, but shell becomes the dominant body volume.

shell-seed80413.note: Prompt produced a freestanding shell/helmet form with no visible organism.

mossy-stone-seed80301.note: Stone and moss applied over a coherent creature with authored support layout intact.

mossy-stone-seed80302.note: Detailed mixed rigid/soft surface while retaining the source silhouette.

mossy-stone-seed80413.note: Cleanest source-preserving stone candidate; strong test of textured rigid reconstruction.
